name: @sheafhq/coherence
description: Cohomological coherence certificate for CI/CD pipelines. Reads a JSON of your pipeline (commit → build → test → deploy events), constructs a cellular sheaf, computes H¹, emits a certificate naming which edges break coherence. Catches the 'our tests passed but prod used a different artifact' failure mode that provenance/attestation tools don't explicitly check. Zero deps, pure TypeScript port of the reference Python implementation.
